From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T15:10:00Z
Subject: POC trial planning & success criteria - Acme Industries

Hi Sanjay - thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have alignment before kickoff: 

Goal / success criteria (what success looks like):
- Baseline comparison vs. current in-house retrieval latency and top-5 relevance (target +15% relevance improvement).
- Sub-200ms median per-request latency in dedicated mode for the sampled query set.
- Integration sanity checks: embeddings generation + search pipeline end-to-end within 3 business days.
- No PII exfil beyond agreed dataset; all logs retained per your retention policy.

Evaluation plan / data:
- Redwood will run a 4-week trial against a holdout of 10k queries (you provide), plus a smaller live sample for integration testing.
- We will instrument token-level cost and latency metrics and provide weekly readouts.

Timeline & milestones (proposed):
- Week 0 (prep): finalize scopes, sign minimal SOW, and exchange data access forms (this week).
- Week 1 (kickoff): technical kickoff + baseline run.
- Weeks 2-4: iteration, model/config tuning, weekly check-ins.
- Week 5: final readout & decision (success/follow-up).

Owners / roles:
- Redwood: Marissa (PM / trial owner), Vivek (Eng lead), Eng on-call for data ingest.
- Acme: Sanjay (Trial lead), Lena (Search eng).

Open items / next steps: 
1) Please confirm the success criteria above or propose edits.
2) Share the 10k query holdout and the data access form (we've attached a template).
3) Preferred kickoff week (we're available Jul 25 or Aug 1).

Attachments: Acme-POC-plan-v1.pdf (POC plan & checklist)

Thanks - I can turn this into a one-page timeline doc after we confirm.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwoodinference.com
